fwr_trajectory.definition: Each expert pair starts from fresh theta3 and receives 20 sequential direct-SGD updates under that forced pair.

natural_trajectory_reference.note: Natural step10/25/50 are checkpoints on the canonical natural-routing trajectory. They are not the same states as FWR k=10/k=20 because the FWR trajectory repeatedly applies forced expert-pair SGD updates.

pre_registered_comparisons.name: fwr_k10_vs_natural_step10
pre_registered_comparisons.description: Descriptively compare FWR positive-pair population at k=10 with the prior natural step10 population. These are not the same trajectory.

pre_registered_comparisons.name: fwr_k20_vs_natural_step25
pre_registered_comparisons.description: Descriptively compare FWR positive-pair population at k=20 with the prior natural step25 population. The natural reference is at step25 and follows a different routing trajectory.

pre_registered_comparisons.name: trajectory_window_direction
pre_registered_comparisons.description: A longer forced-trajectory positive regime indicates persistence under repeated forced updates. A shorter forced-trajectory regime indicates earlier loss of the positive state under forced updating.

interpretation_rule: FWR closure and natural closure are separate measurements. The comparison is descriptive and must not treat equal step indices as trajectory equivalence.
